// Known-bad React code for the Semgrep rules; copied as bad.tsx by the tests, never compiled.
export function Note({ html }: { html: string }) {
  return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }} />; // expect: ws-react-dangerously-set-inner-html
}
export function Wrapped({ html }: { html: string }) {
  return (
    <section dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }}></section> // expect: ws-react-dangerously-set-inner-html
  );
}
